name: voyager-vault
description: Offline travel document vault - Android app wrapper (Capacitor)

scripts.www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -r index.html styles.css app.js db.js zip.js reminders.js native.js icons.js manifest.webmanifest icons vendor www/
scripts.sync: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
